newsitem.title: UK: UK car production up s/a 2.2% in latest six months.
newsitem.headline: UK car production up s/a 2.2% in latest six months.

text.p: Total car production in Britain rose by a seasonally adjusted 2.2 percent in the six months to April, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
Production allocated for the home market rose by 4.1 percent and export production rose by 0.7 percent over the previous six months.
Compared to the same period a year ago, total car production jumped by 11.6 per cent on a seasonally adjusted basis. Export production leapt by 25.2 per cent but home production fell by 1.6 per cent.
Total commercial vehicle production, seasonally adjusted, for the six months ending April was 0.6 percent up on the previous six months and 9 percent up on the same period a year ago.
In the six months to April, unadjusted total car production climbed by 3.1 per cent over the previous six months and by 8.3 percent over the same period a year ago.
